study: Closed-form clipping and height-only ray-equivalent extent
scope: The existing 9310 previously exposed Ordinary Validation descriptions with the locked C_ray_simple inputs, split, score, and fallbacks.

arms.ray_equivalent: All three axes use min(incumbent extent, max(intrinsic extent, extent required by protected points)). Retain the original anchors and outward margin. The output must agree with the sealed all-axis box to 1e-8 m and reproduce its strict metric decisions.
arms.height_only: Use only the vertical term of the clip. Keep horizontal center, length, width, yaw, and original bottom. Keep both real in-box target points and the synthetic old Selection entries. Use the original applicability and fallbacks.

fixed_inputs: Same frozen Qwen replies, four-scale region and Fit/Selection/Audit partitions, selected heading, and incumbent box. No matched-volume target.
audit: Compare incumbent and new entry masks and depths on the associated Selection and Audit sets at 1e-8 m depth tolerance. Audit rays are withheld from the candidate. Verify both actual entry routes on all descriptions and retain every fallback.
evaluation: Seal both predictions before scoring. Report strict IoU > 0.25 and > 0.50, mIoU, paired threshold rescues and harm, recording bootstrap intervals and counts by platform and recording. Reuse the original ground-truth scorer and check the stored baseline and all-axis decisions.
decision_rule: An all-axis mismatch invalidates the implementation check. Treat height-only as a simplification only if the ray and fixed-axis constraints hold, and report the paired accuracy cost and platform differences to inform adoption.
budget: Two deterministic readouts of the same incumbent geometry per description, with a single geometry replay. CPU only, no threshold search, no new Qwen queries or training.
